decisions.reason: The two-component injection unit is core to the firm's announced resin-processing direction and had its own page in both 2018 and 2019, so the firm's sunk investment and visible commitment favour persistence.

As a sibling injection unit with the same sustained dedicated presentation, it shares the firm's commitment to its core line, and weak results can still be attributed to temporary market conditions after 2020.
The automatic airless gun is a central part of the firm's spray equipment range and was consistently promoted on its own page, so management would continue with it.
The manual airless gun is a staple product in the coating equipment portfolio, with consistent visible commitment and low ongoing cost to keep it.
The air-assisted airless gun completes the announced spray gun family, and dropping it would undercut that publicly committed range.
Its downgrade from its own page to a mere mention in 2019 signals waning commitment, but as a complement to the coating equipment and a costly earlier development it is likely still retained.
